problem.title: Max Chunks to Make Sorted
problem.problemStatement: Given a permutation of integers from 0 to N−1, determine the maximum number of chunks into which the array can be partitioned so that sorting each chunk individually results in the entire array being sorted.
problem.input: • First line contains integer N. • Second line contains N integers.
problem.output: Print the maximum number of chunks.
